title: A/P Summary: the CSV is one flat table with plain two-decimal amounts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a new vendor (created for this test), vendor A, with open bills on today's date of $1,250.50 that is 1 to 30 days past due and $99.00 that is more than 90 days past due, and nothing in the other buckets.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Open the CSV in a plain text editor (not a spreadsheet program).
  3. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  4. Open the PDF and look at its last bucket heading.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 2:

  • The file starts with the "As of: " row and the "Locations: All locations" row, then the heading row, which reads the on-screen headings letter for letter, its last bucket column headed "91 And Over", exactly as the screen shows it.
  • One row for vendor A: 1-30 Days reads 1250.50 and 91 And Over reads 99.00 (no $ sign, no thousands comma, two decimals).
  • Current, 31-60 Days and 61-90 Days are blank cells, not 0.
  • The Total reads 1349.50 (1250.50 + 99.00).
  • One Totals row at the bottom, only one.
  • There is no group header or subtotal row: every row except the Totals row is one vendor.

Step 3:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 4:

  • The PDF heading reads "91 And Over" on one line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R7: “The A/R and A/P Summary PDF and CSV head the last bucket column "91 And Over", exactly as the screen shows it; in the PDF the heading stays on one line.”
  • S3-R8: “The CSV starts with the lines of S3-R5, each in its own row, in this order: As of, Locations, then Past due and the customer or vendor line only when set. The column heading row follows directly, then one flat table: one row per customer or vendor (Summaries) or per document (Detail, Collection, Unpaid Invoices), with the aging bucket, customer or vendor in its own column; no group header or subtotal rows; one Totals row at the bottom. Money is a plain number with two decimals, and an empty bucket is a blank cell; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.”
  • S3-R8b: “The CSV column headings are the on-screen headings, letter for letter (S2-R4a): "Customer Full Name" on A/R Detail, "Customer" on A/R Collection, "Vendor Name" on the A/P reports. The bucket column on A/R Detail and A/P Detail is headed "Aging Bucket", and its values are the bucket names shown on screen.”
